scoring_justification: T3 structural: the reproduction target is a set of structural properties of the intensity curves (monotonicity, peak position, asymmetry, absence of separate relrod); no numeric reference values are required, and a full recompute against a gold curve would be overly rigid given differences in implementation details (smoothing radius, geometry factor handling).

outputs.description: Locally averaged diffraction intensity curves along [002] for the expansion case (ε₁=0.1, ε₂=0.05) and contraction case (ε₁=−0.1, ε₂=−0.05), evaluated at f values from 0.9 to 1.1 with step 0.001.

output_contract.notes: The checker will perform structural checks on the submitted curves without using a pre‑computed numeric reference: (1) maximum intensity for each curve at f=1 within one step, (2) monotonic increase as f approaches 1 from below and monotonic decrease above, (3) low‑f side average higher than high‑f side average for expansion, and opposite for contraction, (4) no local maximum in (0.9,0.999) other than at f=1. Passing all checks yields full credit.

steps.description: Structural checks of intensity curves: peak location, monotonicity, asymmetry, absence of separate relrod.
